reasons.action: The intent explicitly requests a performed behavior — a bricklayer laying a course, one brick per hit — so action is governed by the request; no visual reference exists to compete with it.
reasons.medium: No visual reference was supplied; the sole reference is an audio beat reading that carries no visual rendering authority, so the rendering medium falls to the request (already settled as no_reference).
reasons.wardrobe: With no visual reference and no observed subjects, there is no source wardrobe to retain; attire for the bricklayer is left to the request's description of the scene.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies observed lighting, and the audio tempo reference says nothing about illumination; lighting is therefore request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference or actual frame anchors exist to impose a composition, and the 16:9 aspect ratio is a canvas ratio rather than a camera instruction, so framing remains request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference provides color or tonal grading, and the audio reference offers no palette information; palette is thus request-governed.
